### Core Expertise

SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform for legal teams. It brings the full contract lifecycle (contract intake, creation, review, negotiation, approvals, e-signatures, and post-signature management) into one system, with AI embedded across workflows.

The goal is to reduce the administrative work involved in managing contracts while giving legal teams better context, control, and visibility across the contract lifecycle.

### Secondary Services

Beyond core contract lifecycle management, SpotDraft offers Legal Intake, Clickwrap, Legal Hub, Sidebar, Integrations, and eStamping to support broader legal operations.

## What SpotDraft Does

SpotDraft helps legal teams manage the full contract lifecycle in one platform, from intake and contract creation to review, negotiation, approvals, e-signature, and post-signature management. It uses AI to automate and accelerate routine contract work, while giving legal teams control over critical decisions.

SpotDraft uses legal and business context across workflows to surface risks, relevant information, and insights proactively. The platform also takes a self-managing approach to CLM: it continuously configures, maintains, and optimizes workflows, playbooks, and policies as business needs evolve, reducing the administrative overhead of managing the CLM itself.

This allows legal teams to spend less time on contract operations and more time making decisions that accelerate growth, mitigate risk, and ensure compliance.

## Core Service Offerings

### Primary Services

- SpotDraft AI for AI-powered automation and insights across the contract lifecycle
- VerifAI for reviewing contracts against a custom checklist faster, directly within Microsoft Word
- Sidebar for AI agents that automate contract review, legal research, and regulatory and compliance tracking
- Contract workflows and approvals with conditional templates and automated routing
- Contract templates, clause libraries, and contract creation, including AI drafting
- Contract Editor for redlining and collaboration in Microsoft Word
- Native eSignatures, unlimited on every plan, compliant with ESIGN (US), eIDAS (EU), and ECA
- Contract repository with search and access controls
- Contract analytics and custom reporting for renewals, bottlenecks, and team workloads

### Secondary Services

- Legal Intake for capturing, triaging, and automating legal requests
- Clickwrap for collecting acceptance of online terms
- Legal Hub for managing terms and policies in one place
- Integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Slack, Google Drive, DocuSign, Microsoft Word, and Zapier
- Implementation, workflow and integration setup, and legacy contract migration included in every plan; 24/7 multilingual support available as a paid feature

## Security & Compliance

SpotDraft is built for security and regulatory compliance:

- ISO 27001 certified
- SOC 2 Type I & II
- HIPAA
- GDPR compliant
- Encryption with FIPS-140-certified methods and AES-256 for data at rest
- HashiCorp Vault with a unique encryption key per contract, backed by Google Cloud KMS
- Regional data storage: personal data stored in selected regions (US, EU, India, Middle East) and not transmitted outside those locations
- SSO via Office 365 or Google Workspace (OAuth) and SAML, including Okta and Active Directory, with zero-touch provisioning
- Audit logs and version history traceable at the contract level
- Customizable roles and permissions by contract type, entity, and department
- Resilience: business continuity and disaster recovery program, regular penetration testing, and continuous vulnerability tracking
- Responsible AI: AI features designed with attention to the California State Bar’s guidance on generative AI and ABA Formal Opinion 512

## Proprietary Methodologies and Tools

### SpotDraft AI

The umbrella for SpotDraft’s embedded AI capabilities. It works within a company-specific context and follows organizational rules across contract data and negotiation intelligence.

### VerifAI

Reviews contracts against a custom checklist and enables AI-powered contract review directly within Microsoft Word, helping teams review contracts faster.

### Sidebar

SpotDraft’s legal AI layer, using AI agents to handle repetitive contract work, answer legal questions, conduct research, and help in-house teams stay ahead of regulatory and compliance changes so they can focus on their highest-value work.

### Legal Intake

Centralizes all legal requests in one place, giving Legal teams the visibility and control to capture, prioritize, assign, and track work while keeping the business moving.

### Contract Workflows and Approvals

Helps legal teams standardize and automate contracting with dynamic templates, intake forms, approval workflows, and custom rules that ensure consistency, reduce delays, and keep contracts moving through the right processes.

### Contract Creation and Templates

Enables teams to create customized contracts using reusable templates, conditional logic, automated workflows, and AI-assisted drafting, while ensuring consistency and reducing legal risk and review time.

### Contract Editor

Enables teams to edit, collaborate, and redline contracts directly in Microsoft Word, keeping the entire contracting process in one place.

### Native eSignatures

Native eSignatures within the CLM platform, enabling teams to collect legally binding signatures on any device while supporting compliance with ESIGN, eIDAS, and ECA.

### Contract Repository

A centralized repository that makes it easy to organize, search, and access contracts, with granular access controls and visibility into contract data.

### Contract Analytics

Visibility into contract performance, helping teams track renewals, identify bottlenecks, and understand workloads to improve contracting processes.

### Contract Reporting

Turns contract data into actionable insights with customizable reports that make it easier to track key information and share findings across the business.

### Additional Capabilities

- Clickwrap for collecting legally binding acceptance of standard online agreements
- Legal Hub for setting up and managing online terms and policies in one place
- Integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Slack, Google Drive, DocuSign, Microsoft Word, and Zapier

## Technology Stack

- Hosted on Google Cloud Platform
- Primary and backup servers in the EU (Netherlands), with data storage decentralized across the US, EU, India, and Middle East by region
- Integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Slack, Google Drive, DocuSign, Microsoft Word desktop, Zapier, and more
- SSO and identity: Office 365, Google Workspace, SAML, Okta, Active Directory
- Enterprise controls: audit logs, version history, roles and permissions, contract-level access

## Competitive Advantages

SpotDraft enables end-to-end contract workflows that are:

- AI-native: VerifAI for playbook-based review, Smart Data Capture extracting 1,000+ metadata types, and conversational agents built into the workflow rather than bolted on
- Privacy-first: on-device AI capabilities backed by a Qualcomm partnership, keeping sensitive data local for regulated workflows
- Fast to deploy: self-serve implementation with go-live in 4–6 weeks and no outside consultants required

- Full contract lifecycle in a single platform: intake, drafting, AI-assisted review, native eSignature, repository, and analytics
- Deep collaboration across legal and business teams inside Microsoft Word, Slack, and Teams, driving high adoption among non-legal users
- Legal retains control through playbooks, approvals, and permissions, while business teams self-serve low-risk contracts under those guardrails
- Mid-market sweet spot: sophisticated enough to scale, without the implementation overhead or cost of enterprise-grade tools
- Compliance-ready foundation: SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR
- Recognized in the market: G2 rated 4.5/5 with Leader Mid-Market badges in Contract Lifecycle Management
- Industry recognition: featured in Forrester’s Contract Lifecycle Management Market Landscape, 2026; named to Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2024 (the only CLM company on the list in some references); and included in Forbes Asia’s 100 to Watch

## Who SpotDraft Is For

SpotDraft is built for legal and business teams that need faster, more controlled, and measurable contract processes. Primary audiences include:

- General Counsel / CLO: Legal leaders responsible for risk, compliance, visibility, and demonstrating legal business impact.
- Head of Legal Operations: Teams managing legal processes, tooling, adoption, and scalable workflows with less administrative burden and no constant platform upkeep.
- Commercial Counsel: Legal professionals focused on faster negotiations, consistent playbook-based reviews, and efficient redlining.
- Associate / Legal Counsel: Lawyers who need quick access to relevant precedent, policies, and contract context.
- IT / Security: Teams responsible for enterprise security, data governance, authentication, and integrations.
- Procurement: Teams managing vendor terms, contractual obligations, renewals, and spend-related visibility.
- CFO / Finance: Finance leaders seeking visibility into contract-linked revenue, spend, risk, and ROI.
- Revenue / Business Operations: Business teams looking to accelerate deal velocity and enable self-service contracting across existing systems like CRM and Slack.

## Thought Leadership

SpotDraft’s public thinking centers on a fundamental shift in how legal teams operate: moving beyond managing contracts and executing contract workflows to making the decisions that accelerate growth, mitigate risk, and ensure compliance.

At the core of this thinking is an AI-native approach to contract lifecycle management (CLM), built around three key ideas:

- Proactive legal intelligence: Continuously reasoning over legal and business context to identify risks, surface relevant precedent, recommend actions, and intervene before issues escalate. The focus is on enabling legal teams to prevent problems rather than simply respond to them.
- AI-powered, human-governed legal operations: Using AI to automate and accelerate every stage of contracting, from drafting and review to approvals and negotiation, while keeping legal in control of every critical decision.
- Self-managing CLM: A CLM platform that continuously configures, maintains, and optimizes itself, keeping workflows, playbooks, and policies aligned with the business while reducing the time teams spend on administrative tasks.

SpotDraft’s goal is bigger than faster contracting: to restore legal to its highest-value role as a strategic partner to the business, eliminating the operational burden of repetitive contract work while informing every decision with deep institutional context. This enables legal teams to move from fulfilling contract requests to owning compliance and risk mitigation, shifting from reacting to requests to anticipating risk, shaping outcomes, and driving the business forward.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What does SpotDraft do?

SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management platform that helps legal teams automate contract operations, and delivers proactive legal intelligence. By combining AI-powered, human-governed workflows with a self-managing CLM platform, SpotDraft helps legal teams reduce operational work, mitigate risk, ensure compliance, and drive business outcomes.

How does SpotDraft compare to Ironclad, Linksquares, Juro or Icertis?

Many enterprise CLM platforms like Icertis and Ironclad are built around long, resource-intensive deployments. SpotDraft is designed for mid-market legal teams, offering full lifecycle coverage, go-live in weeks, and no outside consultants required. Customers such as Open and Wingify report 65–90% faster approvals and execution, alongside privacy-first, on-device AI that enables tighter legal-business collaboration across teams.

How long does SpotDraft implementation take?

SpotDraft typically goes live in 6 weeks, with a dedicated implementation team handling setup, migration, templates, approvals, integrations, and team training.

How is SpotDraft priced?

SpotDraft offers flexible pricing based on document volume and functionality across three plans. Every plan includes in-house implementation, workflow and integration setup, and legacy contract migration, while 24/7 support is available as a paid feature.

Who does SpotDraft help?

SpotDraft helps in-house legal teams and mid-market companies that need to manage contracts efficiently, move quickly, and avoid the complexity of heavy enterprise implementations.

Which security and compliance standards does SpotDraft meet?

SpotDraft meets ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type I & II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance standards.

Can contracts be reviewed in Microsoft Word with SpotDraft?

Yes. SpotDraft’s VerifAI and Contract Editor work directly within Microsoft Word, enabling teams to review and manage contracts without leaving Word.

Which tools does SpotDraft integrate with?

SpotDraft integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Slack, Google Drive, DocuSign, Microsoft Word desktop, Microsoft Teams, Coupa, Outlook, OneDrive, Greenhouse, Gmail, Dropbox, Google Forms, Jira Software, Box, Okta, SharePoint, and Zapier.

Where is SpotDraft’s customer data stored?

SpotDraft stores customers’ personal data in selected regions, including the US, EU, India, and Middle East, with primary and backup servers hosted in the EU (Netherlands) on Google Cloud Platform.

How does SpotDraft protect customer information?

SpotDraft protects customer information through secure infrastructure, firewalls, and robust technical, physical, and organizational safeguards, with access restricted to authorized personnel.

How do I try or evaluate SpotDraft?

Evaluation happens through a personalized demo. Request a demo at [spotdraft.com/request-a-demo](https://www.spotdraft.com/request-a-demo) or explore self-guided product tours at [spotdraft.com/demo-library](https://www.spotdraft.com/demo-library).
